tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// rgya nag skad du/ gtsug lag 'phrul gyi 'gyur rtsis/ srid pa lha'i skad du/ kong tse ling tse mer ma rol ma zhes bya ba/ bod skad du/ gza' skar gsang ba'i zu tse bskol gyi mdo zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ thams cad kun 'dus ma lus 'byung ba'i phyir// 'byung ba lnga la dbang sgyur 'byung ba lnga yi bdag /thams cad mkhyen pa thams cad yongs kyi rje// nyon mongs ma lus 'dul mdzad pa// nyon mongs dug lnga kun 'dul tshogs// thams cad byang zhing gnas su dag mdzad pa'i/ byang sems sangs rgyas shes rab lnga ldan pa// lha dang lha mo thams cad bzhugs pa kun// thugs rje'i sprul skus 'gro don mdzad pa'i phyir// yid 'ong mdzes ldan pho brang gnas 'dir gshegs// chags med gsal mdzad 'ja' tshon lha yi gnas// rnam dag padma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas ji snyed bzhugs pa la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sems can nyon mongs bag chags sdig sgrib dang*// las ngan 'khrul pa'i dug gsum rtsad gcod phyir/ byang sems nyon mongs dug lnga 'dul mdzad pa// ston pa bla med 'gro ba yongs kyi mgon// de dag thams cad bzhugs pa'i spyan lam du// 'khrul pa'i las dang dug lnga 'khrul// bsad bcad brdung brdeg rku 'phrog dang*// rdzun dang phra ma g.yen dang gcugs// ci bgyis thams cad mthol lo bshags// 'jig rten lha tshogs 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad lha yi dpal// dregs pa can dang gdug pa can// nga rgyal can dang phrag dog can// las dang las ngan las skyes pa'i// bar snang mkha' la rgyu ba'i rje// drang srong chen po gza' chen brgyad// rgyu skar lha mo nyi shu brgyad// sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi gnas// kun tu rgyu dang kun tu 'khor ba'i tshogs// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams gnas pa'i bdag /drang srong rgyal po sprul pa'i 'khor// sum cu rtsa gsum lha yi pho brang du// ji ltar gdan bzhugs yin par bar snang mkha' la 'khor// ri rab ri bo'i mkha' la bzhugs pa kun// drang srong rgyal ba kun mgon lha yi bu// srid pa'i srid rtsa 'byung ba'i bcud sdud pa/

thams cad ma lus 'khor zhing gnas pa'i bdag /gnya' shing 'dzin la sogs pa gser gyi ri bdun skor// rgyal chen ris bzhi bang rim bzhi la gnas// lha srin sde brgyad 'khor na gnas pa'i gtso// lha chen klu dang gnod sbyin chen po dang*// mi min mkha' la rgyu ba'i 'phrul lag sgron khyer tshogs// sprul pa 'bum 'byin rdzu 'phrul mtha' dag ston// ha la 'bar ba gdug pa can gyi tshogs// ha 'dzin gdug pa gser gyi me sgron tshogs/ gnod sbyin gdug pa can dang rgyal po'i tshogs// sangs rgyas bka' 'dzin ston pa'i bka' mnyan pa'i// bdud dang srin po btsan tshogs rmu yi rje// rmu btsan 'khor dang ldan pa'i 'khor lo can// ston pa'i bka' ni 'gyur ba med pa'i don// sra ba'i gos gyon gti mug mun pa sel// gegs 'dul nyon mongs tshar yang gcod// drang srong lha lnga dpang du btsugs// 'gro ba'i don du dkyil 'khor bcas// rgyan dang yo byad mchod pa bshams// me tog gcal bkram chu gtsang sbyar// dri dang tsan dan gla rtsi sbyar// gur gum rgya spos spos me sbyar// 'gro ba'i don du byams sems bskyed// nyon mongs mtha' dag snying rje sgom// 'gyur ba med pa'i pho brang nas// drang srong 'gyur med spyan yang drangs// 'byung ba lnga yi shul yang mtshon// shar phyogs skyed byed shing gi lha// lho phyogs gso byed me yi lha// nub phyogs brtan pa lcags kyi lha// byang phyogs kun gso chu yi lha// tshams bzhi 'gyur med sa yi lha// lha lnga'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// gdug pa 'dul khyed rdzu 'phrul can// sku yi cha lugs bsam mi khyab// sprul pa'i sku mnga' mkha' la 'gro ba'i dpal// khros pa'i cha byad 'gying bag brkyang bskum mdzad// bgrad pa'i zhabs kyis thams cad gnon// thams cad dbang sdud 'byung ba'i lha// 'byung ba'i ngang du ma 'dus gang yang med// dang po srid nas bar du chags// tha ma 'jig kyang 'byung bas 'jig

/'byung ba bya ba'i dbang po che// 'gro ba rigs drug sems can gyi// rkyen dang rgyu dang sa bon rnams// 'byung ba'i 'od gsal 'byung ba lnga yi 'od// 'byung ba lnga yi lha chen rnams// de bzhin de dang ldan pa'i dpal// dpal ldan lha chen tshangs pas bshad// tshangs pa'i gnas nas sgra sgrog pa'i// drang srong lha chen rnams kyis gsungs// 'byung ba lnga la thams cad ldan// thams cad bskyed pas 'byung ba'i lha// cha lugs sna tshogs 'od zer bkra// 'byung ba'i sku la 'od mdangs gsal// thabs kyi sprul pa thabs kyis mdzad// mi mngon rgya mtsho'i rus sbal ltar// ston pa sku sprul sangs rgyas spyan// 'das dang ma 'ongs thams cad gzigs// lha chen lngar sprul 'byung ba'i klong*// klong lnga yangs pa'i mkha' dbyings nas// thams cad 'dul ba'i thig le 'chang*/ phyag stong rnams kyis mtshon cha 'dzin// shes rab ral gris thams cad sgrol// ye shes mda' gzhus sdug bsngal 'joms// thar lam 'byed pa'i stobs po che// dbyings dang ye shes 'gyur ba med// mdzes sdug mdangs ston 'byung ba'i lha// dug lnga spangs pa 'byung ba'i sku// sra brtan 'gyur med sku mnga' ba'i// nyi ma lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba'i// rang byung gsang ba 'byung ba'i lha// thams cad 'dul zhing gegs rnams 'joms// sa yi dug dang me yi dug /shing la gnas pa'i dug 'dul ba/ chu dang lcags ni de bzhin du// gcod 'dral mi mthun 'byung ba'i dug /thams cad ma lus zhi byed shog /phyogs bcur khyab pa'i bde gshegs byang chub sems// de dag la mchod me tog la sogs 'byung ba'i gter// rgyu la mdzes pa'i rin po che// sems can sdug bsngal bskyab pa'i phyir// kong rtse lha yis gsol ba btab// yi dam 'byung ba'i lha lnga mchod// lha lnga mchod pas bde ba thob// bde ba chen po bde ba'i ngang*// de nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/

byang chub ye shes tshogs dang ni// sems can spyi mthun smon lam rgyu// smon lam rang bzhin grub pa'i mchog /mchog ldan sems can kun gyi gter// bsod nams kun la rjes yi rang*/ byang chub lam du sngas bstan nas// rim pa bzhin du tshangs pa'i gnas// bzhi po yang ni kun tu 'brel// kun tu 'brel ba kun tu gnas// 'byung ba'i rgyu las rgyu bstan pa// rgyu med pas ni mtshan ma med// rang bzhin dag gi dngos po rnams// de la de bzhin ngang gis 'brel// bsod nams tshogs bsags 'byung ba'i lha// sku gsung thugs kyi khyad par las// thams cad bskyed pa'i rgyu 'bras 'brel// nges pa'i 'bras bu srid pa'i rgyu// 'byung ba lnga snang srid pa'i phugs// g.yu yi gnam yol kun gyi pha// gser gyi sa gzhi kun gyi ma// ri rab lhun po dngos grub ri// rgya mtsho'i mching rnams bdud rtsi'i snod// ba le stong 'jam smon lam shang*// nam mkha' khyung chen dbang gis phug /nyi zla gza' skar rdzu 'phrul lha// bar snang mkha' la yod pa lhang nger gsal// gnas yin 'khor ba 'byung bas btsal// 'byung ba lnga yi 'khor lo sgyur// rlung lnga 'byung ba'i snying pos bzung*// 'byung ba'i sa bon rlung gis bskyed// 'byung ba'i lha lnga rlung gis grub/ rlung gis rlung chags 'byung ba'i rgyu// thams cad rlung gi klong du yangs// klong yangs rlung gi char chen phob// rlung lha padma'i 'khor lo des// rdo rje rgya gram rlung gi sgyu yis sprul// 'byung ba'i snying po de las bskyed// rlung gis thams cad ma lus mgyogs// rlung gi rgyal po lha yi mchog /sems can ma lus mtha' dag gi /dbugs kyi kha 'byed dbang po'i kha mdangs sel// dwangs snyigs 'byed pa rlung gi mchog /bu gu sel ba rlung gis skyob// ma 'dres gsal bas rlung lnga rdzogs// las mtha' grub pa rlung gis bskyed// rlung gi lha lnga phya las skyob pa ste// bde ba'i 'bras sam rlung gis bskyed// rlung lha gar mkhan lha yi lha// lha yi rgyal pos thams cad mdzad// rlung lha bde ba chen po'i 'i 'khor// sna tshogs gzugs med mkha' la rgyu// dang po rlung gi ngang las 'byung ba chags// 'byung ba'i rten phur rlung gis grub// rlung gi lha chen khyab pa che// thams cad kun tu khyab pa'i dpal// sems can nyon mongs mtha' dag gi

/ma lus sgrib pa sel ba dang*/ rlung las gyur pa'i nad yams dang*// bar chad sdug bsngal rkyen dang byur// lus 'jig tshe nyams dbang thang 'phrog /gegs kyi bar chad ltas ngan than// gdug pa'i las ngan rlung 'khrugs dang*// rlung las rlung 'phar rlung 'bud pa'i// thams cad ma lus de dag gis// gcod dang dbugs ni nyams pa yi// 'khor lo bskor dang gdug pa ston// bar du gcod cing sdug bsngal 'bebs// 'byung ba log pa bdud dang gshed// bdud kyi bar chad sel phyir du// kong rtse lha yi rgyal po yis// bde ba can gyi dkyil 'khor bcas// ting 'dzin g.yo med rab tu bu sgoms// shes rab byams pa'i sems bskyed de// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig 'di brtsams pas// sdug bsngal ma lus thams cad byang*// sngags dang snying po 'di skad brjod// yaṃ yaṃ sal sal ge re du// yaṃ te khru te tshe yang phaṭa// zhi zhi yaṃ ge rgyu ma hā// de skad snying po brjod pa yis// sems can thams cad mdangs dang ldan// kha dog legs shing sha bkrag rgyas// bar chad gegs dang ltas ngan zhi// 'byung ba rlung gi sdug bsngal byang*// rlung gis sems can ma lus gso// thams cad bskyed cing thams cad skyob// rlung gi snying po mdo thig 'di// gser bzhin bcangs shing bklags pa yis// thams cad nad dang sdug bsngal zhi// mi bde sdug bsngal dag par nus// nus mthu de dag 'di las byung*// kong rtse'i rgyal pos 'di bklags pas// rang la bar chad gegs mi tshugs// kun gyis 'khur zhing yongs kyis skyob// de las 'di bklags yon tan che// de tshe byung ba rlung gi 'od las ni// 'byung ba me yi padma 'phros// me las 'od yod pas na me zhes bya/ mthar thug gsal bas me zhes bya// ci yang med pas me zhes bya// thams cad smin grol me yi mchog /nyon mongs 'bar 'bur me yis sreg /me yis las byed thams cad gso// gnyis med gnyis su med par 'khrigs// 'byung ba me yis thams cad mgyogs// 'byung ba mtha' dag gdug rtsub sel// stong nyid bde ba'i ngang la 'dus// theg chen me yis thams cad gso// 'byung ba'i drod 'byin me yi mchog

/me yi kun mthar kun 'byung mchog /me yi lha lnga 'gro ba'i mgon// thugs rjes rgyud ldan sprul pas khyab// nyon mongs sgrib sel dug lnga 'dul// me yi las la byung ba mgyogs// stobs chen me yis rdzu 'phrul 'gyed// kun ldan 'byung ba me yi gtso// gtso bo lnga 'dus me yi lha// gso byed me yis phung po gso// skyed byed me yis tshe srog skyed// mdangs ston me yis lus mdangs bskyed// me lha'i rgyal po agne de// a ram 'phrul gyi khri la bzhugs// tsha tsha 'phro ba'i stobs po che// stong pa las byung 'byung ba'i me// kun la khyab pa'i 'byung ba me// snang dang nyi ma'i 'od chen 'bebs// 'jig rten khams gsum drod ston pa'i// thams cad drod kyi ngang las grol// ri rab rgya mtsho gser gyi sa// de dag thams cad drod las 'tsho// chags pa chen po me yi drod// kun tu snang byed me yi 'od// thams cad kun tu khyab pa'i mchog /sems can nyon mongs mtha' dag gi /ma lus bag chags sel ba dang*// skyon sgrib sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i 'dam// me las gyur pa'i nad rnams dang*// tshad pa'i nad dang 'khru nad dang*/ bar chad sdug bsngal rkyen dang byur// mi 'phrad pa yi 'jigs pa dang*// me yi tshad nad 'khor ba'i dug /me dug me nad tsha ba'i nad// lus 'jig phung po 'khor ba'i bdud// che nyams dbang thang ku ba'i gegs// gegs dang bgegs chen las kyi bdud// nyon mongs 'dod chags 'khor ba'i gshed// gshed bdud nyon mongs ltas ngan than// gdug pa'i las ngan tsha ba g.yob/ tsha dang sreg dang 'phar ba'i nad// skem byed smyo spyod byed pa'i nad// sdug bsngal mtha' dag stong pa'i bdud// me las gyur pa'i nad sel ba// kong rtse lha yi rgyal po yis// kun ldan 'phrul gyi dkyil 'khor bcas// ting 'dzin 'khrul med rab tu bsgoms// snying rje ldan pa'i sems bskyed de// dag pa gser gyi mo do thig 'di brtsams pas// nyon mongs mtha' dag sdug bsngal byang*// snying po sngags chen 'di dag brjod// raṃ raṃ snying phur raṃ ge re 'du/

tsa ba phaṭa/ ma ma raṃ te nye phur// me gha dha sang zhi ba 'dul// de skad snying po brjod pa des/ sems can thams cad drod dang ldan// dbang po gsal zhing bde ba thob// nyon mongs sdug bsngal dag las thar// ltas ngan than dang bar chad zhi// 'byung ba me yi sdug bsngal byang*// me yis sems can ma lus bskyed// thams cad bskyed pa me yi mthu// me yi snying po mdo thig 'di// gser bzhin bcangs shing bklag par 'os// thams cad sdug bsngal mi dge bas// nad dang skyon gyis bsdus pa'i bgegs// de dag thams cad dag par nus// nus mthu thams cad de las 'byung*// kong rtse'i rgyal pos 'di bklags pas// rang la bar chad gegs mi tshugs// 'byung ba me yi lha yis skyob/ bsod nams dbang thang rgyas par nus// me las gyur pa'i sdug bsngal zhi// las ngan bdud kyi gegs rigs 'dul// des na bklags pa'i yon tan che// de tshe me yi tsha ngar las// 'byung ba chu yi 'khor lo chags// thams cad chub pas chu zhes bya// chu yis thams cad kun tu khyab// khyab pa chen po chu yis phul// sprul pa'i las la grub pa'i chu// sna tshogs bzhi ldan bdud rtsi'i klong*// bdud rtsis grub pa chu yi lha// du mar gsal ba chu yi mchog /'byung ba chu yi shugs las grub// lcags drag ngar chen chu yi rgyu// shugs ldan chu yi kha dog las// sems ldan 'khor ba'i sha khrag bskyed// lus dang sems su gnas khyed chu// chu yi bdud rtsi chu yi ngang*// 'khor lo shugs ldan chu yi rlan/ rlan byed chu yis 'byung ba gso// rtsal gsum rdzogs pa'i thig le can// zad pa med pa'i thig le 'chang*// thig le 'gyur med me la brten// me yi snying po rlung gis bzung*// chu yis thams cad bskyed pas chu// g.yo ba'i rang bzhin ngang du 'dus// 'dus pa'i chu rgyun zad pa med// rgya mtsho lta bu chu yi ngang*// ngang las g.yo 'gul med pa'i rten// chu yang lha chen du mas brten// ri rab gser gyi gling chen bzhi// de bzhin de yi rlan gyis btsas// 'gyel ba med pa sra brtan theb// rol pa'i mtsho bdun de ltar chags// mdo rgyas mdo 'phel 'byung ba de ltar chags// 'byung ba chu yi lha chen gtso// chu las bdud rtsi rang 'khyil che// 'khyil zhing rnyogs pa rang bzhin shugs// rlan byed chu yis phung po bskyed// bdud rtsi chu yis phung po gso// kun grub chu yis 'bras bu 'tsho// 'dod byed chu yis gti mug sbyong*// chu lha'i rgyal po 'khor lo can// 'khor lo lnga ldan phyag las 'grems// ye shes lnga yi sdong po rgyas// pha rol phyin pa'i de bzhin nyid// rnam shes drug ldan phung po'i bcud// bcud ldan bcud 'phel 'byung ba chu// chu yi ngang ldan 'khyag cing grang*// zla ba'i 'od ldan de bzhin gsal// 'jig rten khams gsum gso bskyed mdzad// khams gsum thams cad chu yis gso// de ldan de bzhin chu dang ldan// chu yi 'byung ba chu la rdzogs// de bzhin gnyis 'brel thams cad 'byung*// kun tu grub pa chu yi lha// bag chags sgrib sel chu yi mthu// mthu stobs de yis nyon mongs 'dul// dga' ba grub pa kun gyi mgon// mgon mdzad mgon gyis thams cad skyob// thams cad re ba skyabs kyi mchog

/de bzhin 'byung ba chu las 'ong*// sems can nyon mongs mtha' dag gis/ ma lus sdug bsngal sbyong ba dang*// skyon dang bag chags sdig sgrib dang*// bar chad rkyen dang 'byung ba'i dgra// chu las gyur pa'i gdon dang gegs// grang ba chu las gyur pa'i nad// ma zhu ba dang rdel nad dang*// rgyu mkhris rgyu nad chu yi dug /zas zos dug tu gyur pa yis// rmu chu chus khyer chu dgra dang*// chu g.yos chu dgra 'gul ba zlog /gdug pa'i than ltas ngan pa zlog /mi yi lus la nyams bsod dang*// gzugs kyi phung po bshig pa dang*// tshe srog bar du gcod pa zlog /kha rje dbang thang dag la ku ba dang*// 'byung ba las ngan gegs dang bdud// bdud dang las la 'khor ba'i gshed// 'jig rten spyi mthun bsod nams 'phrog /kun la 'tshe ba byed pa rnams// de dag thams cad zhi bar mdzod// kong rtse lha yi rgyal po yis// bsod nams rab 'phel dkyil 'khor bcas// yi dam lha gsal 'gyur med ting 'dzin bsgoms// tshad med bzhi ldan byams pa'i sems bskyed de// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig 'di brtsams pas// sdug bsngal phrag dog dug lnga'i sgrib pa byang*// snying po sngags tshig 'di dag brjod// maṃ maṃ sa maṃ du ye maṃ 'du/ pra ha ra hūṃ du phaṭa// maṃ dha ka sha khaṃ ra du// de skad snying po brjod pa des// sems can thams cad sha lus rgyas// dbang po'i dwangs ma kun kyang gsal// 'khrul pa med cing g.yo ba med// rang bzhin lhun grub bde ba thob/ byams pa ldan zhing snying rje che// sems can mi la gnod pa bskyal ba de// than ngan la nye ngan pa dang*// thams cad 'di yis thar bar 'gyur// 'byung ba chu yi sdug bsngal byang*// chu 'di sems can kun gyi gsos su che// thams cad gso ba chu yi mthu// chu yi snying po mdo thig 'di// gser bzhin bcang zhing bklag par bya// sdug bsngal bag chags sgrib pa dang*// dri zhugs dri ma ngan pa dang*// nad ngan mi gtsang la sogs dang*// de dag thams cad dag par 'gyur// nus mthu de dag 'di las 'byung*// kong rtse'i rgyal pos 'di bklags pas// bar chad gegs kyis mi tshugs dang*// 'byung ba chu yi lha yis skyob// za thang bsod nams rgyas par 'gyur// chu las gyur pa'i nad rnams dang*// de dag myur du zhi bar lta// des na 'di bklags yon tan che// sngon tshe chu yi rba rlabs las// rin chen gser gyi sa gzhi grub// 'gyur ba med cing g.yo ba med// rang bzhin khang dang rim gyis chags// sa gzhi rin po che yi ngang*// thams cad mdzes pa'i gser dang ldan// gser gyi ngo bo kha dog las// sa yi snying po rab tu bzang*// 'phar ba med pa gser gyi brjid// rang bzhin gnas pa sa yi mthu// 'byung ba sa las rin po che// lnga ldan 'byung ba lnga yi shugs// gang 'dod thams cad de las 'byung*// sems can 'dod pa de yis skong*// bla med ston pa'i thugs rje dang*// sangs rgyas byang sems rab rdzogs pa'i// dge ba'i rtsa ba de bzhin 'grub// de ldan sems can nyon mongs spangs// de bzhin mthong med 'gyur mi srid// de bzhin de ldan 'byung ba'i ngang*// ngang las ma g.yos rin chen sa// bde ba bkod pa gser gyi phugs// thams cad rten la thams cad gnas// 'pho med 'gyur med sra zhing brtan// 'gro ba rigs drug de bzhin gnas// thams cad gnas pa sa yi gzhal yas mchog

/'byung ba sa yi dkyil 'khor rgyas// kun tu khyab pa'i sde brgyad rin po che// kun la dgos pa de bzhin yod// dad ldan mos pa'i sems dang phrad// gti mug mun pas bsgribs pa yi// nga rgyal can de me yi 'khor// sa las spyod pa sa yi ngang*// thams cad de bzhin sa las grol/ byams sems ldan pa ye shes che// lha mo brtan ma sa yi lha// rdzu 'phrul gzugs 'chang sa yi bcud// sa las grol bar kun gzhi rgyas// rgyas pa rab ldan rab kyi gzugs// sa chen gsum po 'gro ba'i don// 'byung ba'i gzugs can de ru rdzogs// skye shi med pa sa yi khams// khams brgyad rnam shes sprul pa yi// sprul skus khyab pas khams gsum dbyings// sa chen 'gyur ba sa ya bcud// bcud du rdzogs pa ri rab yin// kha dog 'byung ba lnga las grub// rin po che yi 'od lnga 'bar// sna tshogs gzugs can 'byung ba'i gzugs// thams cad de la gnas shing 'khor// 'byung ba lnga las grub pa'i mchog /mchog tu ldan pa lha yi gnas// sa yi lha lngas thams cad bskyed// khyab byed sa yi gzugs phung bskyed// bde ldan sa yis bkrag mdangs 'byin// gsal ldan sa yis 'od mdangs ster// kun ldan sa yis dran pa sbyor// sa yi lha lngas thams cad gso// bde ba dran pa sa yis byed// sa yis bya ba thams cad 'grub// skal ldan 'byung ba'i gter la spyod// bag chags byang bas byang chub gter// kun tu spyod pa sa yi bcud// de bzhin 'byung ba sa yi rtsi// bdud rtsi bya ba sa yi bcud// de las lhag pa'i bdud rtsi med// gso bskyed 'byung ba de yis thams cad gso// sems can nyon mongs mtha' dag la// ma rig 'khrul pa'i sdug bsngal dang*// ma rig sems kyi zhen chags dang*// rtog pa med pa'i bying rmugs dang*// le lo btang snyoms nad dang skyon// shi zhing chad dang brlag pa dang*// sa las gyur pa'i gdon dang bgegs// lci zhing 'thibs pa'i nad dag dang*// smyo dang 'bog dang rmugs dang non// sa gzhi sa g.yos sa 'gul zlog

/sa nang sa yi cho 'phrul gshed// tshe la gnod dang bar du gcod// dus min 'chi dang sgra ngan sgrogs// gdug pa'i cho 'phrul ston pa'i tshogs// de dag thams cad zhi bar mdzod// kong tse lha yi rgyal po yis// 'byung ba'i mdo thig 'di brtsams pas// 'khrul pa ma rig ma go ba'i// nyon mongs bying rmugs sgrib pa byang*// snying po sngags chen 'di dag brjod// khaṃ sa sil ma du ma gi du ma ye/ khaṃ ke ma hā a mu du/ de skad snying po brjod pa des// sems can thams cad dga' ba bskyed// lus rgyas bcud 'phel sha khrag gsal// gdug pa can gyi gnod pa zhi// mi gdug cho 'phrul mtha' nas sangs// legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel// byams sems dang ni snying rjer ldan// thar pa'i bde lam thob par 'gyur// sa yi sdug bsngal nyon mongs sgrib pa byang*// sa la gnas pa'i sems can bgegs// thams cad 'gegs pa sa yi stobs// sa yi snying po mdo thig 'di// gser bzhin bcang bzhin bklags pa yis// mi mthun rkyen dang sdug bsngal than// las kyis mnar ba'i sems can nyon mongs bdud// nus mthu 'di yis dag par nus// kong tse'i rgyal pos 'di bklags pas// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa dang*// sa bdag sa las mi ldang dang*// sa gdon gdug pa can gyis nyams mi sod// 'byung ba'i lha yis rtag tu khur// sems can nyon mongs skyobs par nus// sa las gyur pa'i gdug pa zhi// 'di bklags yon tan mtha' dag 'phel// de tshe 'byung ba bzhin g.yos pas// nam mkha' me tog bzhin du ni// gsal ba'i 'od 'bar lhang nge gsal// gdod nas ma skyes stong pa'i ngang*// ci yang med pa stong pa'i ngang*// dang po stong pa'i ngang nyid las// mkha' la 'od chags nam mkha'i klong*// 'gyur ba med pa nam mkha'i dbyings// nam mkha'i ngang ni log pa ste// 'byung ba lnga po de las 'dus// de nyid ngo bo sems kyi yul// sems nyid la yang ngo bo med// sems kyi mtshan nyid sems su rdzogs// sems nyid stong pa'i rang bzhin no// stong pa skye ba med pa'i dbyings// ngang gis ma g.yos ngang gis 'brel// dbyer med 'pho 'gyur med pa'i ngang*// dngos po med pa stong pa'i ngang*// mtshan ma brjod bral stong pa'i ngang*// g.yo med skye med dngos po med// ci yang med pa nam mkha'i ngang*// nam mkha'i ngang la dbyings nyid rdzogs// nam mkha'i ngang la ci yang med// 'byung ba'i kha dog mtshan ma med// stong nyid stong pa'i de bzhin gnas// nam mkha' 'byung ba'i ngo bor rdzogs// 'byung ba byas pa med pa'i ngang*// phyogs dang mtshan ma de bzhin med// kha dog ngo bo med pa sems kyi rtsal// sems la bzung du med de ci yang med// nan ltar ltas na gang yang mi gnas pa// sems kyi dpe ni nam mkha' 'dra// dpe yis dpe rtsal 'khrul pa med// 'khrul med sems dang nam mkha'i klong*// rdzogs pa chen po de la yod// chos nyid dbye ba med pa thig ler 'dus// sems dang 'gyur med nam mkha' gnyis// bsgrub byar yod pa ngo mtshar che// rtsal ldan rdzogs pa sems kyi rtsal// nyon mongs spangs pas rang sems bde// sems kyi gnad du 'khrul pa med// 'khrul pa'i rtsa ba ma rig pa// ma rig pa yang 'khrul pa yin// rnam par rtog pa sems kyi dug

/nam mkha'i dngos po mi 'gyur yang*// glo bur char sprin khug rna dang*// rmugs pas bsgribs pa lta bu'o// skyon dang 'grogs pa nam mkha'i ngos// nam mkha' rdzu 'phrul sangs rgyas bka'// byas pa med par kun tu shes// byang chub bzhi ldan kun tu shes// byang chub bzhi ldan de bzhin dbyings// lha rnams rig pa de bzhin gnas// 'khor ba gnas lngar spangs byas te// thams cad rang bzhin rdzogs pa'i sa// bde ldan bde ba thob pa'i sa// nam mkha' sems kyi 'khor lo skor// 'khor lo lnga ldan ye shes lnga// ye shes lha lngas thams cad khyab// srid pa 'gro ba'i 'byung ba che// 'byung ba bzhi 'dus nam mkha'i mkha'// mkha' dbyings rnam par dag pa'i klong*// rtogs na rang sems sangs rgyas te// ma rtogs pa la gtsug lag dgos// ma rig 'khrul snang gtsug lag pa// g.yo med nam mkhas gzugs phung bskyed// dpal ldan nam mkhas sha khrag 'byin// grub pa'i nam mkhas thams cad skong*// thams cad ma lus bskyed pa de// 'byung ba nam mkha'i klong du 'dus// rang bzhin lhun rdzogs grags pa che// dpal ldan gsal ba de la 'dus// gsal bden sgrib pa med pa lam gyi mchog /'khrul med brtan pa gnas kyi mchog /mchog dang ldan pa de la 'dus// de bzhin gnas pa de yi ma// sems can nyon mongs mtha' dag gi /las ngan sdug pa'i bag chags sdig sgrib dang*// nyon mongs las kyi bar chod dang*// gdug pa ston pa'i bgegs rigs stong*// cho 'phrul ston dang than ngan 'bebs// lus gnod srog la rku dang 'tshe ba byed// tshe la glo bur gtong ba'i tshogs// nam mkha'i gdon dang lcags kyi gshed// lcags las gyur pa'i nad yams dang*// skran nad dang ni rus nad dang*// lcags 'khrug glo bur drag shul dang*// gro dang mda' mtshon 'khor ba dang*// ye 'brog sum brgya drug cu dang*// nad rigs brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang*// lcags las gyur pa'i gri yi tshogs// gdug pa'i thog dang gnam dal dang*// de dag thams cad zhi bar mdzod// kong tse lha yi rgyal po yis// ye shes lnga ldan dkyil 'khor bcas// thabs ldan shes rab 'phrul gyi ting 'dzin bsgoms// lta ba mtha' dag nyams su myong ba'i sems bskyed de// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig 'di brtsams pas// sdug bsngal las kyi nyon mongs sgrib pa byang*// sngags ni/

oṃ a mer ti ba ro ma khrer duṃ ma a raṃ khe ra na yu/ a hūṃ khye nya ma hūṃ/ de skad snying po brjod pa des// sems can thams cad dran pa rnyed// gsal ldan sems dang ldan par 'gyur// dbang po rgyas pas kun gzhi bde// sku gsung thugs kyi phung po rten// 'jig med 'gyel med brlag pa med// 'byung ba lcags kyi gdug pa dang*// gcod 'bigs rgyag pa'i gdug pa zhi// 'byung ba lcags kyi sems can rten// thams cad rten pa lcags kyi stobs// lcags kyi snying po mdo thig 'di// gser bzhin bcang zhing bklag par 'os// nyon mongs ma rig 'khrul pa'i bdud// shes bya ma rtogs gti mug klong*// zang zing gnod pa phrag dog bgegs// de dag thams cad dag par nus// nus mthu 'di las 'byung bas bklag par bya// kong tse'i rgyal pos 'di bklags pas// bgegs zhi sdug bsngal rab tu byang*// drag byed bdud dang 'tshe byed btsan// lha srin sde brgyad gdug pa'i tshogs// nyams mi sod la kun gyis 'khur// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel bar 'gyur// nam mkha'i rgyal pos rtag tu 'khur// sems can kun la phan 'dogs nus// lcags las gyur pa'i gnod pa zhi// dngos grub bdud rtsi char bzhin 'bebs// des na 'di bklags yon tan che// de tshe 'byung ba rnam pa lnga*// gzugs med dngos kyi cho 'phrul dang*// gsung med sgra yi rang bzhin las// thams cad chags pa 'byung ba'i rgyu// 'byung ba chags pas sems can gnas// sna tshogs sems cad de yis grol// 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// thams cad 'bras bu de yi ngang*// kun 'byung gzugs kyang de las blang*// 'gro ba rigs drug de las grol// rgya mtsho chen po de las chags// rgya mtsho'i dwangs ma byol song dang*// klu rnams chang 'gags sbang ma 'dra// gcig sha za zhing gcig khrag 'thung*// gcig gis gcig gsod byol song yin// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// sngon tshe 'byung ba cha ma snyoms// de ltar sems can rigs drug la// sdug bsngal de bzhin khur ba yin// drang srong bka' ni ma thos sangs mi rgya// sems can rgyu yin 'bras bu sangs rgyas yin// byams dang snying rje rgyud la dgos// de med ngan song gsum gyi rgyu// mtsho gling 'o ma'i rdal khyab nas// ston po chen po 'gro ba'i mgon// bla med sa bcu ston pa yis// mkhyen rab bdag po 'jam pa'i dpal// ma hā gser sbal ser po ru// sku sprul 'gro ba'i don yang mdzad// rgya mtshor zhugs nas 'gro don mdzad// 'gro don mdzad phyir rus sbal sku ru sprul// mgo las me yi rus sbal bu tsha'i gab rtse dang*// glo g.yas shing gi rus sbal pha khu'i gab rtse dang*// mjug las chu yi rus sbal gnyen lam mtha' bzhi'i gab rtse dang*// glo g.yon lcags kyi rus sbal nor grogs gab rtse dang*// yan lag bzhi las sa yi rus sbal ma phyi yul mkhar gyi gab rtse dang*// de dag la sogs rgyas par gtan la phab// ma ni kun la byams pas ma// sems can sems la brtse bas ma// hā ni dug gsum skyon gyis ma gos pa'i// de yi phyir na hā zhes bya// gser ni rin po che yi mchog

/kun gyi nor bu che ba dang*// sems nyid rin chen gser du bstan// cis kyang mi 'gyur bcos su med// de yi phyir na gser mdog bstan// 'gyur ba med pas kha dog ldan// chos sku'i brda' mtshon thig le can// yang na mchod rten ri mo can// longs sku'i brda' mtshon rus sbal sprul// sprul skus gang la gang 'dul ston// kyis ni thams cad de la 'dus// thams cad 'dus pa gnas kyi dbyings// rus zhes bya ba 'byung ba'i khams// 'byung ba lcags cha me sa shing*// sbal ni ston pa lha yi sku// skye shi med pa byang chub dang*// snang srid thams cad de ru 'dus// de las ma grol gang yang med// thams cad rus sbal sku las grol// ston pas 'gro ba'i don du bstan// 'gro don mdzad phyir rus sbal lo// pha ni thabs kyi rang bzhin te// ma ni shes rab rang bzhin yin// yab yum gnyis med 'brel ba las// ma hā gser sbal ser por bstan// sems can rgyal po grangs mang yang*// mkhyen rab bdag pos rus sbal sprul// gzhan las khyad 'phags rus sbal yin// 'byung ba 'gyur med thig ler ldan// sa bdag pho mo bu tsa drug /tsha yug la sogs spar kha brgyad// rus sbal mgo dang yan lag rnams la grol// 'byung ba lnga por de bzhin 'dus// lta ba thams cad yas phug cig /ma rtogs sems can snying re rje// gnyis su lta ba nyon re mongs// gnyis med thams cad gcig tu 'dus// thams cad 'dus pa'i ston pa'i sku// sku lnga sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i gnas// 'gro ba'i don du so sor bstan// dug lnga dag pas ye shes lnga// rab ldan thob pas thams cad snang*// gsal snang khyab pas gnyis zhes bya// 'byung ba'i bcud stobs rin chen sa// sa la lnga tshan sa bdag bu// rgyal rigs rje rigs bram ze'i rigs// gdol pa'i rigs ni ngan sems can// bsam pa ngan pas 'tshe bar byed// de bzhin lha yi rgyal pos bshad// lha yi bsod nams thugs rje yis// 'gro ba'i don mdzad sdug bsngal sel// rab tu sel ba'i skyabs chen po// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs mtha' dag la/

gnod pa rnam pa sna tshogs byed// nyon mongs gdug pa'i cho 'phrul can// dug 'chang dug gi nga ro can// 'byung ba rnam lnga'i snying po yis// dug sel ston pas sku sprul pa// ma hā gser sbal ser po yis// rnam shes brgyad las grol ba'i bgegs// sa la dbang sgyur sa bdag tshogs// de dag gdug pa bsal phyir du// kong rtse lha yi rgyal po yis// kun shes kun grol gsal ba'i dkyil 'khor bcas// bden pa lung gsal stong pa'i ting 'dzin sgom// man ngag thig le nyag gcig gsal ba'i lha bskyed de// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig 'di ston pas// sa bdag zhe sdang gdug pa can rnams zhi bar 'gyur// sdug bsngal byang dang sgrib pa dag par shog /snying po sngags chen 'di dag brjod// a bā sarba ra ga dhu a ma rag sha ma hā hūṃ// hūṃ hūṃ dha dha dhu ka ma ye dha ke tsha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ de skad snying po brjod pa des// lha yis mthu 'byin rtag tu rgyas// byams pa kun ldan dga' ba che// btang snyoms kyis ni pha rol phyin// nyan pa'i yid la spro ba skyed// dud 'gro mtha' dag bde ba thob// sa bdag gdug pa'i sems zhi ste// phrag dog gtan spangs zhi bar grol/ nyon mongs gdug pa'i sems bor te// bde ba chen po'i ngang la gnas// rus sbal cho 'phrul sa bdag bu/ de yi gdug pa ltas ngan than// 'byung ba 'thab pa'i dgra gshed dang*// mi mthun 'khrugs pa'i gcod 'dral zhi// rus sbal thams cad rten pa'i gnas// gser gyi kha dog 'byung ba'i bcud// bcud rgyas bcud 'phel rus sbal sku// ston pa'i thugs rje phun sum tshogs// rus sbal snying po mdo thig 'di// gser zhing bcang zhing bklag par 'os// sems can thams cad spro ba skyes// dga' ba ldan zhing yid sems mos// sprul pa ldan cing lha yis skyob// gdug pa'i sems yid phyir bor te// de dag skyon sgrib dag par 'gyur// nus mthu thams cad de las byung*// de bzhin ldan pas bklags par 'os// kong rtse'i rgyal pos 'di bklags pas// rang lus dbang rdzogs dbang dang ldan// kun gyis khur zhing yongs kyis bstod// thams cad yongs la nyams mi nga*// rang bzhin bsam pa gser bzhin la// ci bsam 'grub la ci dgos 'byung*// ci smras bden la ci ltas mthong*// snang gsal me long bzhin du gsal// mthong gi bya ba thams cad gzigs// rus sbal lha yi dbang chen thob// kun tu dgos pa thams cad 'byung*// rus sbal sku la mchod 'dzin na// bde gshegs dngos grub rang bzhin thob// sems can kun la phan 'dogs nus// tshe ring tshe dang ldan par 'gyur// nor med nor rdzas 'phel bar nus// des na 'di bklags yon tan che// de tshe lha yi thugs rje dang*// phyi rabs 'gro ba 'dren phyir du// rgya mtsho 'khyil ba'i pho drang du// ma hā gser sbal ser por sprul// sprul pa'i sku la ri mo bkra// ma bris ye nas yod pa'i gzugs// sku gdung mchod rten padma bkra// thams cad de las ldan pa'i gnas// sangs rgyas ston pa'i zhabs bcags so// 'gro ba yongs la thugs rje che// thugs rje'i sman pa de dang ldan// sku gsung thugs kyi yan tan ldan// yan lag brgyad sprul spar ba brgyad// li khon dwa khen kham dang ni// gin zin zon dang rnam pa brgyad/

phyag rgya brgyad dang yang dag ldan// rang bzhin lhun grub lhun gyis gnas// brgyad ldan shes rab ye shes me bo che// dug lnga sreg byed 'joms par byed// li ni rus sbal mgo las chad// stong nyid stong pa'i ngang las 'phro// pha rol phyin pa'i sa bcu rdzogs// sa cig rab tu dga' ba'i sa// bcu bzhi bar du rab tu ldan// srid pa gsum la lam gyis bgrod/ lcags bzhin gyong rtsub mthar byed de/ byams pa'i ngang dang bden pa'i tshig /gang bltas 'brel ba'i dam tshig gis// lta sgom gcig tu gnas pa'i mi// thar lam bde ba 'byed pa'i lung*// de la bde bas lung bstan bzhag /nam mkha'i 'khor lo sems kyi mdzod// thams cad sems kyis 'byed pa'i phyir// dug lnga nyon mongs sdug bsngal can// mkhyen pa can ni khen la gnas// kun gzhi bde ldan dri med chu// khams brgyad ldan pa lam gyi ngang*// rigs gsum mgon po sangs rgyas zhing*// rig byed ldan la sprul pa'i sku// mi bla bslu med bde ba'i sa// bde ba can gyi zhing mchog na// padma rab ldan byang chub zhing*// 'dzin chags med pa 'byung ba'i rtsis// 'byung ba'i snying po rlung la thug /rlung gis thams cad skyed par par byed// dgra med dug 'dul zon la gnas// thams cad gnas su ston pa yin// 'og nas gong du spar bas spar/ nam mkha' mkha' ltar khyab pas mkha'// rnam shes brgyad rdzogs phyir na brgyad// spar kha brgyad po lha yi lung*// snang srid kun la khyab par grol// 'byung ba bdun ldan khyab pa che// legs pa'i yon tan tshang bas lha// nyes pa'i skyon dang ldan pas bdud// lha bdud gnyis po de ltar gnas// khyen la gnam yang ldan rmongs pa// thabs kyi mchog dang yang dag ldan// khon ma sa yang shes rab lung*// bu tsha drug ni pha rol phyin dang ldan// sems can nyon mongs skyob pa'i phyir// sdug bsngal phrag dog ngan sems dang*// gnod sems than ngan zang zing dang*// khen gyi khran gzer gnam dal dang*// kham gyi kha mchu smra lag byur// gin gyi ltas ngan the'u rang than// zin gyi glo bur nad drag dang*// zon gyi smyo nad 'bog nad dang*// li yi tshad nad me yi dgra// khon gyi sa g.yos sdig sgrib dang*// dwa yi gzer nad gri 'khrug btsan// de dag zhi bar mdzad slad du// kong rtse lha yi rgyal po yis// bde ldan 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor bcas// 'khrul med bsam gtan ting 'dzin sgoms// yi dam 'byung ba'i lha lnga bskyed// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig 'di bklags pas// mi mthun 'byung ba'i gcod 'dral dang*// spar kha brgyad kyi thug 'dom dang*// sa bdag gdug pa'i sdug bsngal zhi// snying po 'di ni brjod par bya// oṃ a ga ni dha sha /sku gsung thugs dang ldan pas mthon*// rig pa bzhi dang ldan pas ni// shing gi bag dang ldan pas ljang*/ ye shes lnga ldan rdzogs pas ser// pha rol phyin drug sgrib med dkar// 'byung ba bdud ldan theg pas dmar// rnam shes brgyad ldan bag chags med pas dkar// theg pa rim dgu phyin pas dmar// theg pa bgrod pa'i stobs po che// dgu ldan nges par ye sangs rgyas/ byams pa'i thig le 'gyur ba med// theg pa rim dgu lta ba'i klong*// gang la goms pa de bzhin 'dus// sna tshogs ting 'dzin sgom pa'i lam// sgom lam rnyed pas thar lam thog /thar lam thob pas rdzogs sangs rgyas// tha snyad med pa'i sa bcu gnon// de las thar pa'i sems can kun// phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas// 'byung bas bskyed pa'i rgyu 'bras ni// ji bzhin sems la bskor zhing lta// 'khrul med sems kyi yon tan lta// yon tan ldan pas dge ba'i mchog /lta ba de dang ldan pas na// 'jig rten tha snyad yid mi 'gyur// rus sbal yan lag pho brang gi /yon tan de rnams kun gyis rtogs// sems can nyon mongs ma rig pas// las ngan spyad pas zhe sdang can// blo ngan gti mug 'khrul pa'i gzhi// rnam rtog dra bas bcings pa'i dug /rnam rtog gyur cing nor ba na// gnod dang 'gal bas sdug bsngal 'bebs// thams cad 'drer langs sbyang ba'i phyir// kong rtse lha yi rgyal po yis// 'byung ba lnga ldan dkyil 'khor bzhengs// gdon dang gegs zhi 'byung po 'dul// lha min dri za lto 'phye dang*// nam mkha' lding dang grul bum dang*// srin po bdud kyis mi tshugs so// rog dan byed cing mgon skyabs mdzad// tshe ring nad med lus po bsrung*// dpal med dpal dang ldan par byed// sred med bu tsha'i dbang thang spel// des na 'di bklags yon tan che// de tshe 'byung ba lnga yi mdog /dkar ser sngo nag dmar ba yis/ tshangs pa lha chen de yi 'khor// sangs rgyas ston pa'i thugs rje'i ngang*// 'gro ba mtha' dag kun gyi rten// lo skor zla skor bcu gnyis chags// dang po chags pa rlung gis bskyed// 'byung ba lnga po rang bzhin gnas// thabs kyis bskyed pas 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba yongs la de bzhin gnas// lus can lus te lus kyi mchog

/lo skor bcu gnyis lus dang ldan// ston pa lha yis sku bzhengs pa// lo yi mdzad thabs gtan la phab// gtan tshigs nges tshig lung gis bshad// zla ba bcu gnyis de la 'khor// 'khor 'das rgyas pa lha yi sku// longs spyod rdzogs pa de bzhin sku// dug lnga'i dgra 'dul gnod pa zhi// sku las gzugs bskyed rab tu ston// ting 'dzin dgongs pa lha yi lus// g.yo ba med pa'i lta ba rtogs// nyon mongs bying ba byi ba yin// thabs dang shes rab glang bas glang*// ri mo phra bas stag tu byung*// de ltar yod pas yos zhes bya// rgyud lung man ngag chu ltar 'brug /bsam gtan bzhi po kun tu sbrul// rta yi longs spyod sna tshogs mdzes// thams cad man ngag lug pas lug /yi dam lha la phreng bas spre'u/ bya don thams cad 'grub pas bya// yangs pa'i dbyings nyid 'khyal bas khyi// ngo mtshar kun las 'phags te phag /thams cad 'dus te sangs rgyas bka'// ston pas lung bstan kun gyi nor// dpe zla ngo mtshar che bas lha// bcu gnyis rang bzhin rgyud las 'phel// zla ba bcu gnyis zhag za ma// dus tshod la sogs de la bskor// rig cing rtogs na thams cad 'byung*// ma rig mi rtogs go ba med// ci yang med pa bya yi lam// skam la phyung ba'i nya bzhin du/ de phyir de yis sa me chod// tha ma brlag ste 'bras bu 'tshig /de la soms la sems can gyi// ston pa'i bka' nyan lung khrol nas// las ngan thams cad rang sar grol// sangs rgyas bya ba de la zer// 'bras bu ming stor chud mi gson// sems can nyon mongs mtha' dag gi /las ngan sgrib pa'i mun pa byang*// las ngan 'khor ba'i gdug pa rnams// kun gyis ma rtogs gnod pa'i gegs// las ngan gdug pa'i gegs dang 'brel// de yis bcings te ltas ngan than// lo skor bcu gnyis zla ba'i gshed/ mi mthun gcod la rlung log cig /lo skeg zla skeg zhag skeg dang*// za skeg la sogs 'byung ba'i bdud// gcig bdud gcig la gnod pa'i byur// de dag thams cad zhi bar mdzod/

kong rtse lha yi rgyal po yis// sna tshogs dag gsal mdzes pa'i dkyil 'khor bcas// ye shes lnga ldan ting 'dzin bsgoms// kun gsal kun grol lha tshogs spyan drangs nas// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig 'di bton pas// lo skor bcu gnyis bar chad 'khrul pa'i bdud// lo skeg zla skeg yod pa'i gshed// lo gnas ngan dang lo khyim zhig /tshe phur phyung dang mjug thag chad// brtan phur cha ga gam rgya ma zhig /rlung log pa dang dar gung g.yos/ na shi gud pa dur zhugs bu/ mdun khur kha yan se zhig bdud// gza' bzhi sum 'dom ltas ngan than// de dag zhi bar mdzad slad du// snying po sngags chen 'di brjod do// oṃ a sa hūṃ ge ri te phaṭa/ dha ha na ma sa ra ma tre dha na hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhi zhi ma la ma la 'bur ma ke she ma hā ha na hūṃ hūṃ swā hā// de skad snying po brjod pa des// yon tan ldan zhing byin rlabs 'phel// dga' ba grub cing mos par 'gyur// thams cad gdug pa'i skeg las grol// 'phreng can 'byung ba'i dgra gshed zhi// 'byung ba'i gcod 'dral bdud las thar// lo zla zhag dang za ma dang*// dus tshod kun gyi 'dre srin 'dul// dag pa gser gyi mdo thig 'di bklags pas// phyogs bzhi'i lha 'dre gdug pa dang*// gtum dang rngam dang khro dang tshig /mi ma yin gyi cho 'phrul rnams// de bzhin byang zhing med par 'gyur// dga' mgu snying rje byams par ldan// 'gro ba yongs la phan 'dogs nus// kun tu 'grol ba 'byung ba'i lha// bdud gshed gcod pa rab tu zhi// nyon mongs rab sems 'gro ba'i mgon// mgon skyabs mdzad pa 'byung ba'i lha// 'byung ba'i lha chen kun gyis skyob// lo skor zla ba'i snying po mdo thig 'di// bcangs shing bklags te sngags brjod na// gegs kyi bar chad nyams mi sod// ji ltar bklags pas yon tan 'byung*// rtog pa choms shing dgra gshed thul// rab tu dga' ba'i lha dang 'grogs// thams cad nyon mongs dag par nus// de dag thams cad dag pa'i phyir// nus mthu ci bsams de las 'byung*// de ltar ldan pas bklag par 'os// kong rtse 'phrul gyi rgyal po yis// yi dam rtag tu 'di bklags pas// gnyen sbyor rtsi ba'i gab rtse phrug
